Question: If someone has broken fasts by eating without an apparent reason and at the sametime does not remember the number of fasts broken in this way, then what can be done now for qadha,bear in mind the exact number of the broken fasts is also not known. Jazakhallah khair! Answer ID: 8839 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2316/1914=B/1429) If anyone broke the fast of Ramadhan deliberately without an excuse he will have to keep the fast again and give kaffarah (expiation). If one does not exactly know how many fasts he has broken then he will be asked to have most likely idea of the total numbers and he will have to fast accordingly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
